text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager delivered to primary (tara) — embeddings-service p99 errors spike, 30% of requests returning 500s. Root cause unknown, started ~13m ago.

 tara: hey team, I'm wrapping my shift. brief status below — please ack if you can take as primary.

 leo: i'm around, can take primary for next 4h. quick questions: any customer-facing throttles applied?

 tara: yes — applied temporary rate cap at the edge: `X-Rate-Limit: 120/s` for embeddings paths. We also rolled back the last hotfix (deploy 2026-03-15_06) because logs showed a malformed batched tensor. rollback cmd we ran:

 ```
 kubectl rollout undo deployment/embeddings-worker -n prod --to-revision=12
 ```

 We also spun up 6 extra replicas while investigating: `kubectl scale deploy embeddings-worker --replicas=24 -n prod` — CPU usage still middling, but error rate persists.

 chris: errors look like `ValueError: invalid kv cache shape` in the worker logs. I ran a grep and saw ~2000 hits across primaries. dumping a sample stack:

 ```
 Traceback (most recent call last):
   File "/app/serve.py", line 412, in handle_batch
     kv = load_kv(batch)
 ValueError: invalid kv cache shape: expected (1024, 64) got (512, 64)
 ```

 sara: that smell like a quantized model mismatch / kernel mismatch after the hotfix rollback. Are we sure all nodes are on the same model version and quantization profile?

 tara: good point — it looks like the rollback left a mix: approx 30% of pods still had `model:v3-quant` image. I flagged them and started a rolling restart with the pinned image `model:v3-quant-fixed`.

 mike: i'll run `kubectl get pods` and `kubectl describe pod` to confirm. also adding a temporary route to second tier so customer impact reduces. command:

 ```
 # add traffic-split rule
 redwoodctl route set-split embeddings --primary=canary --secondary=fallback --secondary-weight=20
 ```

 leo: ack, i'll take primary. plan while i'm on shift:
 - verify all pods are `model:v3-quant-fixed` (if not, force replace)
 - revert the edge cap to avoid throttling once routing fallback is stable
 - monitor p99 and customer errors for 30m
 - if errors continue, enable per-request KV validation patch (hotfix PR#4892)

 tara: notes for you — runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-p99 (section 'mixed image rollbacks'). quick commands I used to scrub bad pods:

 ```
 # drain and replace
 kubectl delete pod <podname> -n prod
 # confirm image
 kubectl get pods -n prod -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].image}' | tr ' ' '\n' | sort | uniq -c
 ```

 ops-bot: incident updated — severity set to P1, pager notified to rotation. Incident channel: #inc-4891-embeddings

 sara: customer impact — 3 customers reported degraded embeddings (regen errors); two are high-touch. CS already notified. tickets: CS-3321, CS-3322. ETA for next update: 20m.

 leo: i'm primary. handoff checklist:
 - [x] confirm primary/secondary in rota (tara -> leo)
 - [x] attach runbook link
 - [ ] confirm all pods on `model:v3-quant-fixed`
 - [ ] watch p99 and error-rate for 30m
 - [ ] if >10% error persist, enable hotfix PR#4892 and call eng-ml

 chris: i'll be standby secondary for escalation. ping me before enabling PR#4892 — need to coordinate CPU/kernel tests.

 mike: updated route, fallback now handling ~18% of traffic. seeing reduced 500s for a subset of requests. continuing log sampling: `kubectl logs -l app=embeddings-worker -n prod --since=10m | grep -i 'ValueError' | wc -l` -> 540

 leo: thanks — everyone please react with :thumbsup: to acknowledge takeover. I'll post a status update at +15m and +45m. if anything changes earlier i'll ping in this thread.

 tara: thanks team, leaving notes in pager doc and adding my contact. handing over now. :wave:

 (Added by leo) Checkpoint 15m: p99 dropped from 2.8s -> 1.4s after route split and forced pod replacements. customer regen errors down from 30 -> 7 in last 15m. continuing watch. :ok_hand:
